Bill.BriefDescription: Using certain state sales tax proceeds to maintain lifeguards at state parks.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to using certain state sales tax proceeds tomaintain lifeguards at state parks; adding a new section to chapter82.32 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The parks lifeguard account is created in the state treasury. Thestate treasurer shall deposit proceeds received under RCW 82.08.020from the furnishing of lodging, or the granting of any similar licenseto use real property, if the real property is under the care, charge,control, or supervision of the Washington state parks and recreationcommission. Moneys in the account may be spent only afterappropriation. Expenditures from the account may be used only by thecommission to maintain lifeguards at state parks.
